title: [BUG] /release-notes command not up to date
body:

- Operating System: <!-- e.g. macOS 14.3, Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04 -->
- Terminal:  <!-- e.g. iTerm2, Terminal App -->

## Bug Description
I just upgraded Claude Code to 0.2.39. The `/release-notes` command only shows changes up to 0.2.37.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Ensure you have Claude Code 0.2.39+ installed.
2. Run Claude Code
3. Issue the command `/release-notes`.

## Expected Behavior
To see the changes up to the current version.

## Actual Behavior
Even though I'm running 0.2.39, I only see changes up to 0.2.37.
